title: ledger/master.json -> spice_certificates (liability block)
description: Written by Hwi after each daily accrual run (after the 16:00 PT fix), one row per certificate, produced from ledger/spice-certificates.csv. master.json rides the nightly archive, so NO personal data: no display_name, email, wallet address or payout address. The holder page/API reads exactly this block. Display names live only in the private, non-archived holder file (holders.private.json).

network.description: testnet on preview; mainnet only after gate 1

as_of.description: when Hwi wrote the block (ISO 8601 with offset)

btc_price_usd.description: the daily fix used for value_usd (decimal string)

accrual_rule.default: floor(100*0.08/365/fix*1e8) sats per cert per day; ACT/365; issue day excluded; stops at payout approval

holder_ref.description: opaque key into holders.private.json; not derived from any personal data

last_reserve_credit_pt.description: last Friday the week's sats were credited to the withdrawal holding

token_hash.description: sha256 of the holder's tailored-link token (the token itself is never stored); null = no link / revoked
